normalization.definition: initial expected sensory-to-Core absolute current, averaged across Core cells and the entire fixed trial, including neutral baseline/cue/padding and two equally weighted visual outcomes
normalization.limits: Per-cell distribution remains sparse. Poisson refractory losses and learned weight drift are measured, not corrected using test outcomes. ON/OFF has no static current.

limits: Diagnostic sensors are hand-defined visible features, not autonomous vision
Short-delay visual validation can be weak; prediction negatives then do not exclude internal information
The fixed normalizer matches initial population-mean expected current, not every cell or learned current
Controlled exploration and visual-to-action transfer do not demonstrate autonomous goal pursuit
protocol_details.matched_experience_definition: paired equals aged_frozen in actual training frames/actions/timing; scrambled preserves executed keys/timing and frame marginals, with independent pairings
protocol_details.readout: M3 standardized visual-only centroids, count and eight relative time bins; independent chronological visual validation

sensor_anchor.sampling: 256-square canonical raster, 4x exact tiling of existing 64-square renderer; floating-point rectangle area averages before coding
